mapper.select: SELECT id, isbn, title, author, type, description, total_copies, available_copies FROM books WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, isbn, title, author, type, description, total_copies, available_copies FROM books
AND ( LOWER(title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') OR LOWER(author) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') )
AND type = #{type}
ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, isbn, title, author, type, description, total_copies, available_copies FROM books WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET available_copies = available_copies - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND available_copies > 0
UPDATE books SET available_copies = available_copies + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND available_copies < total_copies
